Game Overview

Fluffy Clicks puts players into a clicker experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Fluffy Clicks doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Fluffy Clicks?

Fluffy Clicks is a free clicker game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Fluffy Clicks free to play?

Yes, Fluffy Clicks is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
